verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in feature that notifies customers when a feature's status changes. What it does show is building blocks: webhooks that report entity changes in real time, API endpoints linking feedback to users, companies and features, and feature status tracking. A team could combine these to build its own notifier, with an external messaging tool doing the sending. missing for 10: native customer notification on feature status change, documented status-change triggers to the customers who asked, built-in email or portal messaging to requesters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
